notes.title: Announcing the Fountain of Light Update!
notes.content:
Version 0.7.0 brings 30 new levels, a whole new world, and an entirely new in-VR way to share your levels with other players around the world and explore the creations of other Architects of Light. The Fountain of Light update will be available for you to experience before the end of the month!

[h1]The Community Altar[/h1]

After completing at least level 15 of World 1 you’ll find a new lumen waiting for you, ready to raise the new Community Altar from the sea. At this new altar you can search for levels created by your friends and other Architects of Light, levels curated by Blueprint Reality, or put your trust in the stars and receive a brand new level for a chosen world.

[url=https://awaken-game.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/social_hd.png]The Community Altar[/url]

You can share your own levels at the Create Altar by solving them once you’re done editing and then placing them in the share column on the right of the altar.

[url=https://awaken-game.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/skyward_hd.png]The Create & Community Altars[/url]

[h1]World 2 and the Great Lynx[/h1]

A new world and its Guardian are in peril! The darkness has inflicted a grievous wound on the Great Lynx that defends the light of this world overseen by a gas giant and floating islands of rock. Warmth and chill play pivotal roles in this world, each with their own unique parts, behaviours, and modifiers for existing puzzle elements.

[url=https://awaken-game.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/elemental_primitives_hd_tmp.png]Fire and Ice Elements[/url]

Mastering these elements will require an eager mind and no small amount of thoughtful experimentation!

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

Our new Community Altar will expand with new features to come in future updates, including more tools for finding the perfect level for you based on a variety of criteria. We also want to provide more feedback on how your shared levels are being received by other players, including a system for ‘favouriting’ a level to save it for later and tell others they should give it a try.

Don’t forget to [url=https://www.facebook.com/awakenvrgame/]Like[/url]/[url=https://twitter.com/awaken_game/]Follow[/url]/[url=http://subscribe.awaken-game.com/]Subscribe[/url] to any of our social channels or check out Awaken-Game.com for all the latest updates!

[h1]We want to hear from you![/h1]

You are an important part of making Awaken an incredible experience for its full launch and beyond! Awaken is still very young and we’re here to listen to what you love about it now and how you wish it would improve in the future.

You can submit your feedback in-game or at http://feedback.awaken-game.com, or join the community discussion at http://discuss.awaken-game.com!

Thank you for participating in our Early Access journey and we hope you enjoy the Fountain of Light Update!

notes.title: Blueprint Challenge Pack & 0.6.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch 0.6.3 is live and brings with it two key improvements!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[b]Blueprint Challenge Pack[/b]
[list]
[*]The first Blueprint Challenge Pack with 10 unique new puzzles is now available to players who have completed all 30 of the levels currently available at the Story Tree. These levels can be found on the other side of the tree.
[/list]

[b]Gif Recorder[/b]
[list]
[*]The Gif Recorder can be enabled in the desktop menu. This creates a movable camera component in VR that can be used to record 5-second gifs and screenshots. Simply point the controller at the screenshot or gif button of the camera in VR and press the trigger to activate. You'll find the output screenshots in C:\Users\<username>\AppData\LocalLow\Blueprint Reality\Awaken\
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing the Blueprint Challenge Pack!
notes.content:
[h1]Hungry for some new Awaken puzzles?[/h1]

We're excited to announce a new set of free, unique levels will be released [b]tomorrow[/b] in the first Blueprint Challenge Pack! The Blueprint Reality team has crafted a selection of new puzzles ranging from deviously simple to cosmically complex.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27428832/e869c707b2278419ac65bd39f76844469d78a80a.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27428832/8019d5158972fb8c1cbd5dd28bbeb36cd0f2bb63.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27428832/cf83c68bdd68aa4c06de60f174ed588685257450.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27428832/c19582974c52fbdefb2b02e6b43e55d82ffc1b4c.png[/img][/url]

Once update 0.6.3 is released tomorrow, February 9th, look for the new crystals at the [i]Story Tree[/i] after completing the first 30 levels!

[b]Also, stay tuned for a big reveal[/b] next Tuesday, February 14th, of our upcoming content update in 0.7.0! Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, Steam, or check out Awaken-Game.com to stay ahead of all the Awaken news!

[b]In the meantime, we want to hear your feedback![/b] Our question to you for the week is: Do you have any solutions you’re particularly proud of? Share them with the [url=http://discuss.awaken-game.com]Steam community[/url]!

notes.title: Awaken Launch Level Creating Contest
notes.content:
[h1]Win one of three VR-ready NVIDIA graphics cards![/h1]
Blueprint Reality is proud to announce the launch of its inaugural game,[b] Awaken.[/b]

We are pretty excited and we want you to get in on the action so we are having an Awaken Launch Level Creating Contest.

To participate you simply need create your very own level in Awaken using the level editor mode and submit it to Blueprint Reality at [b]contest@blueprintreality.com[/b].

[b]Find out how to share your Awaken levels [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/555970/discussions/1/133255603286018266/]here[/url]![/b]

Entries will reviewed based on beauty, creativity, fun and sense of awe!

[h1]Did we mention the prizes?![/h1]
  • First place:      GTX 1080 – appr. value – $599 USD
  • Second place: GTX 1070 – appr. value – $379 USD
  • Third place:     GTX 1060 – appr. value – $249 USD

 
Submit your entry no later than March 16, 2017*.

Chances of winning will depend on the number and quality of the entries.

Good Luck and Enjoy Creating!

[url=https://awaken-game.com/contest][u]*see full contest rules [/u][u]here[/u][/url]
[img]https://awaken-game.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/geforce_gtx_1080_3qtr_front_left.png[/img]
Prizes may not be exactly as shown, please see full contest rules for details. Image credit NVIDIA.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.1 Notes
notes.content:
Patch 0.6.1 is live and brings a few final fixes as the game becomes available to the world! For more information and discussion about Awaken, past and upcoming updates, join the discussion at discuss.awaken-game.com!

And as always, we love to hear your thoughts, feedback and bug reports at feedback.awaken-game.com.

[b]Elements & Puzzles[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the rail element could become immovable
[*]Fixed an issue where an element could become ‘stuck’ to the player after teleporting
[/list]

[b]Presentation[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue resulting in the red moon briefly disappearing in World 1
[/list]

[b]Sanctuary & Altars[/b]
[list]
[*]Newly-created puzzle crystals now have the correct orientation
[/list]

Still experiencing a problem? Check out our Known Issues post on the forums.
